本回合对手英雄下一次受到伤害时，创造一个敏捷衍生物。
shift_the_tide_of_battle.text_en:
Target Warrior attack with {p} greater than its base gets go again.
The next time an opposing hero is dealt damage this turn, create an Agility token.

shifting_tides.text_zh:
再动
在你的回合开始时，资源你牌库顶的一张牌。若其为蓝色，将此牌置于其拥有者的牌库底。否则，摧毁此牌。
shifting_tides.text_en:
Go again
At the start of your turn, pitch the top card of your deck. If it's blue, put this on the bottom of its owner's deck, otherwise destroy this.

shifting_winds_of_the_mystic_beast.name_en: Shifting Winds of the Mystic Beast
shifting_winds_of_the_mystic_beast.type_zh: 秘法 忍者 行动
shifting_winds_of_the_mystic_beast.text_zh:
本回合每当你使用卧虎时，说出一张牌名。它获得该名称。
若你为使用此牌资源过一张气，在你的手牌中创造2张卧虎。
再动
shifting_winds_of_the_mystic_beast.text_en:
Whenever you play a Crouching Tiger this turn, name a card. It gets that name.
If a Chi was pitched to play this, create 2 Crouching Tigers in your hand.
Go again

shimmer_of_the_blade.text_zh:
目标武器攻击获得+3力量。
瞬间——弃掉此牌：创造一个剑舞衍生物。
shimmer_of_the_blade.text_en:
Target weapon attack gets +3{p}.
Instant - Discard this: Create a Blade Dance token.

shimmering_mirage.text_zh:
当此牌防御时，当此链环结算时，放逐此牌。本战斗链中你可以使用它。
幻景

While this is defending, when this chain link resolves, banish this. You may play it this combat chain.
Mirage

shimmering_specter.text_zh:
当此牌攻击或防御且离开竞技场时，创造一个幻质护盾衍生物。
幻景

While this is attacking or defending, when this leaves the arena, create a Spectral Shield token.
Mirage

shimmers_of_silver.text_zh:
每回合一次，当你用幻术师光环武器攻击时，在其上放置一个+1力量指示物。
幻尊
shimmers_of_silver.text_en:
Once per turn, when you attack with an Illusionist aura weapon, put a +1{p} counter on it.
Spectra

shining_courage.text_zh:
至多一个目标防御行动牌本回合获得+3防御。
观众为你欢呼。
shining_courage.text_en:
Up to one target defending action card gets +3{d} this turn.
The crowd cheers you.

shitty_xmas_present.text_zh: 将一张来自游戏外的破裂饰物置于目标英雄的牌库顶。
shitty_xmas_present.text_en: Put a Cracked Bauble from outside the game on top of target hero's deck.

shiver.type_zh: 元素 游侠 武器·弓 （双手）
shiver.text_zh:
每回合一次瞬间——支付1点资源：你可以将你手牌中的一张箭矢牌正面朝上放入你控制的一个空军械库区域。若如此做，选择其一；
它直到回合结束获得+1力量。
它直到回合结束获得支配。

shiyana_diamond_gemini.text_zh:
你的牌库中可以包含任意英雄的专精牌。
在你的行动阶段开始时，希亚娜成为目标英雄的复制品直到你的下一个回合开始，并获得"你拥有的牌除其原有职业类别外还视为你的英雄的职业。"
shiyana_diamond_gemini.text_en:
You may have specialization cards of any hero in your deck.
At the beginning of your action phase, Shiyana becomes a copy of target hero until the start of your next turn, and gains "Cards you own are the class of your hero in addition to their other class types."

shock_charmers.text_zh:
瞬间——支付2点资源：本回合你控制的攻击行动牌下一次命中英雄时，对其造成1点伤害。
法力虚空2
shock_charmers.text_en:
Instant - {r}{r}: The next time an attack action card you control hits a hero this turn, it deals 1 damage to them.
Spellvoid 2

shock_frock.text_zh:
行动——摧毁此牌：获得1点资源。仅当本回合你使用过一张闪电牌时才能启动此异能。再动
战痕
shock_frock.text_en:
Action - Destroy this: Gain {r}. Activate this only if you've played a Lightning card this turn. Go again
Battleworn

shock_striker.text_zh: 每回合一次瞬间——支付2点资源：电击打击者获得“若电击打击者命中英雄，对其造成1点伤害。”
shock_striker.text_en: Once per Turn Instant - {r}{r}: Shock Striker gains "If Shock Striker hits a hero, deal 1 damage to them."

shoot_your_mouth_off.text_zh: 当战斗链关闭时，若此牌没有命中，防御英雄创造一个自信衍生物。
shoot_your_mouth_off.text_en: When the combat chain closes, if this didn't hit, the defending hero creates a Confidence token.

short_and_sharp.type_zh: 刺客·忍者 攻击反应
short_and_sharp.text_zh:
选择其一；
- 目标匕首攻击获得+3力量。
- 目标基础力量为2或更低的攻击行动牌获得+3力量。

short_shrift.text_zh:
若此牌的力量大于其基础，它获得+1力量。
粉碎——当此牌对英雄造成4点或更多伤害时，该英雄弃一张牌。
short_shrift.text_en:
If this has {p} greater than its base, it gets +1{p}.
Crush - When this deals 4 or more damage to a hero, they discard a card.

shove_off.text_zh: 选择一张防御你控制的剑攻击的非装备牌。将其移回其拥有者的手牌。
shove_off.text_en: Choose a non-equipment card defending a sword attack you control. Return it to its owner's hand.

show_no_mercy.text_zh:
里纳尔专精
当此牌攻击英雄时，威吓该英雄。
若防御英雄手牌中没有牌，此牌获得+3力量。
show_no_mercy.text_en:
Rhinar Specialization
When this attacks a hero, intimidate them.
If the defending hero has no cards in hand, this gets +3{p}.

show_of_strength.text_zh: 每有一张力量为6或更高的牌防御此牌，此牌获得-1力量。
show_of_strength.text_en: This gets -1{p} for each card with 6 or more {p} defending it.

show_time.text_zh:
布拉沃专精
当表演时间！进入竞技场时，从你的牌库中搜寻一张守护者攻击行动牌，展示它并将其置入你的手牌，然后洗牌。
在你的行动阶段开始时，摧毁表演时间！，然后抽一张牌。
show_time.text_en:
Bravo Specialization
When Show Time! enters the arena, search your deck for a Guardian attack action card, reveal it and put it into your hand, then shuffle your deck.
At the beginning of your action phase, destroy Show Time! then draw a card.

showdown.text_zh:
你本回合的下一次剑攻击获得+3力量，以及“当此牌攻击时，与防御英雄下注。胜者创造一个连击衍生物。”
再动
showdown.text_en:
Your next sword attack this turn gets +3{p} and "When this attacks, wager with the defending hero. The winner creates a Flurry token."
Go again

shred.text_zh: 本战斗链中目标防御刺客攻击的牌获得-4防御。
shred.text_en: Target card defending an Assassin attack gets -4{d} this combat chain.

shriek_razors.text_zh:
当此牌在你坟场中时，在你的回合开始时，你可以摧毁你控制的2个银币。若如此做，装备此牌。
攻击反应——支付2点资源，摧毁此牌：目标防御刺客攻击的攻击行动牌获得-1防御。
战痕
shriek_razors.text_en:
While this is in your graveyard, at the start of your turn, you may destroy 2 Silvers you control. If you do, equip this.
Attack Reaction - {r}{r}, destroy this: Target attack action card defending an Assassin attack gets -1{d}.
Battleworn

shrill_of_skullform.type_zh: 符文剑士 行动·攻击
shrill_of_skullform.text_zh: 若本回合你使用过或创造过一个光环，骷髅形态尖啸获得+3力量。

Blood Debt

When this leaves the arena, create a Sigil of Fate token.
Blade Break

Put up to 4 cards from your hand on the bottom of your deck, then draw that many cards.

When this leaves the arena, draw a card.

sigil_of_deadwood.type_zh: 符文剑士 行动·光环

sigil_of_fyendal.text_zh:
再动
在你的行动阶段开始时，摧毁此牌。
当此牌离开竞技场时，获得1点生命。
sigil_of_fyendal.text_en:
Go again
At the beginning of your action phase, destroy this.
When this leaves the arena, gain 1{h}.

sigil_of_gravespawning.type_zh: 符文剑士 行动·光环
sigil_of_gravespawning.text_zh:
再动
每当一个光环离开你的坟场时，对目标英雄造成1点秘法伤害。
在你的行动阶段开始时，摧毁此牌。
sigil_of_gravespawning.text_en:
Go again
Whenever an aura leaves your graveyard, deal 1 arcane damage to target hero.

sigil_of_lightning.text_zh:
在你的行动阶段开始时，摧毁此牌。
当此牌离开竞技场时，创造一个闪电化身衍生物。
sigil_of_lightning.text_en:
At the beginning of your action phase, destroy this.

sigil_of_parapets.text_zh: 当此牌防御时，每当你使用法师牌，城垛印记获得+2防御。
sigil_of_parapets.text_en: While Sigil of Parapets is defending, whenever you play a Wizard card, Sigil of Parapet's gains +2{d}.

sigil_of_permafrost.type_zh: 元素 法师 防御反应
sigil_of_permafrost.text_zh:
冰融合
若永久冻土印记已融合，本回合你下一次对英雄造成秘法伤害时，在其控制下创造等量的霜咬衍生物。
sigil_of_permafrost.text_en:
Ice Fusion
If Sigil of Permafrost was fused, the next time you deal arcane damage to a hero this turn, create that many Frostbite tokens under their control.

sigil_of_protection.text_zh:
结界4
在你的行动阶段开始时，摧毁守护印记。
sigil_of_protection.text_en:
Ward 4

sigil_of_sanctuary.text_zh:
秘法庇护1
当此牌离开竞技场时，创造一个大地化身衍生物。
sigil_of_sanctuary.text_en:
Arcane Shelter 1
When this leaves the arena, create an Embodiment of Earth token.

sigil_of_shelter.text_zh: 本回合接下来你将受到伤害时，防止其中2点伤害。
sigil_of_shelter.text_en: The next time you would be dealt damage this turn, prevent 2 of that damage.

sigil_of_silphidae.type_zh: 符文剑士 行动·光环
sigil_of_silphidae.text_zh:
再动
当此牌进入或离开竞技场时，你可以放逐你坟场中的另一个光环。若如此做，对目标英雄造成1点秘法伤害。
在你的行动阶段开始时，摧毁此牌。
sigil_of_silphidae.text_en:
Go again
When this enters or leaves the arena, you may banish another aura from your graveyard. If you do, deal 1 arcane damage to target hero.
At the beginning of your action phase, destroy this.

sigil_of_solitude.text_zh:
在你的回合开始时，若你控制另一个幻术师光环，摧毁此牌。
结界4

At the start of your turn, if you control another Illusionist aura, destroy this.
Ward 4

sigil_of_suffering.type_zh: 符文剑士 防御反应
sigil_of_suffering.text_zh:
对攻击英雄造成1点秘法伤害。
若本回合你造成过秘法伤害，苦难印记获得+1防御。
sigil_of_suffering.text_en:
Deal 1 arcane damage to the attacking hero.
If you have dealt arcane damage this turn, Sigil of Suffering gains +1{d}.

sigil_of_temporal_manipulation.text_zh:
在你的行动阶段开始时，摧毁此牌。
当此牌离开竞技场时，放逐你牌库顶的一张牌。若其为非攻击行动牌，本回合你可以将它当作瞬间使用。
sigil_of_temporal_manipulation.text_en:
At the beginning of your action phase, destroy this.
When this leaves the arena, banish the top card of your deck. If it's a non-attack action card, you may play it this turn as though it were an instant.

sigil_of_the_arknight.type_zh: 符文剑士 行动·光环
sigil_of_the_arknight.text_zh:
再动
在你的行动阶段开始时，摧毁此牌。
当此牌离开竞技场时，展示你牌库顶的一张牌。若其为攻击行动牌，将其置入你的手牌。
sigil_of_the_arknight.text_en:
Go again

When this leaves the arena, reveal the top card of your deck. If it's an attack action card, put it into your hand.

sigil_of_voltaris.type_zh: 闪电 符文剑士 瞬间·光环

sigil_of_voltaris.text_en:
When this enters or leaves the arena, deal 1 arcane damage to target hero.
At the beginning of your action phase, destroy this.

signal_jammer.text_zh:
信号干扰器进入竞技场时带有一个蒸汽指示物。
在你的行动阶段开始时，除非你从此牌上移除一个蒸汽指示物，否则摧毁它。
每位英雄每回合不能使用超过1张“非攻击”行动牌。
signal_jammer.text_en:
Signal Jammer enters the arena with a steam counter on it.
At the beginning of your action phase, destroy Signal Jammer unless you remove a steam counter from it.
Each hero can't play more than 1 'non-attack' action card each turn.

silent_stilettos.text_zh:
每当你控制的攻击中的盟友死亡，或你控制的攻击行动牌被虚击摧毁时，你可以支付3点资源。若如此做，摧毁无声细高跟鞋并获得1个行动点。
秘法屏障1
silent_stilettos.text_en:
Whenever an attacking ally you control dies or an attack action card you control is destroyed by phantasm, you may pay {r}{r}{r}. If you do, destroy Silent Stilettos and gain 1 action point.
Arcane Barrier 1

silken_form.type_zh: 龙裔 幻术师 装备·手臂
silken_form.text_zh:
瞬间——摧毁丝绸形态：将你控制的目标灰烬转化为以太灰翼。
镇压1
silken_form.text_en:
Instant - Destroy Silken Form: Transform target ash you control into an Aether Ashwing.
Quell 1

silken_gi.text_en: Instant - Destroy Silken Gi: The next attack action card you play this turn has -1{p} and costs {r} less to play.

若你军械库中没有牌，查看你牌库顶的4张牌。你可以将其中的一张箭矢牌正面朝上放入你的军械库，然后将其余牌以任意顺序置于你的牌库底。

Go again

silverdrop_downpour.text_en:

swarming_gloomveil.text_en: If you have played or created 1 or more auras this turn, Swarming Gloomveil gains go again. If you have played and/or created 2 or more, it gains +1{p}. If you have played and/or created 3 or more, it gains "When this hits a hero, they can't prevent arcane damage from sources you control this turn."

sweeping_blow.type_zh: 龙裔 幻术师 行动·攻击
sweeping_blow.text_zh:
当你用横扫一击攻击时，创造一个灰烬衍生物。
再动
sweeping_blow.text_en:
When you attack with Sweeping Blow, create an Ash token.
Go again

swell_tidings.text_zh:
对目标英雄造成5点秘法伤害。
激涌——若此牌造成超过5点伤害，创造一个沉思衍生物。
swell_tidings.text_en:
Deal 5 arcane damage to target hero.
Surge - If this deals more than 5 damage, create a Ponder token.

swift_pickup.text_zh:
当此牌攻击时，你可以将你坟场中的一个手里剑物品置于你的牌库底。若如此做，此牌获得+1力量。
再动
swift_pickup.text_en:
When this attacks, you may put a shuriken item from your graveyard on the bottom of your deck. If you do, this gets +1{p}.
Go again

swift_shot.type_zh: 游侠 行动·箭矢 攻击
swift_shot.text_zh: 当此牌被正面朝上放入你的军械库时，本回合它获得再动。
swift_shot.text_en: When this is put face-up into your arsenal, it gets go again this turn.

swiftstrike_bracers.text_zh: 行动——摧毁此牌：你本回合的下一次攻击获得+2力量。仅当本回合你使用过一张轻灵之道时才能启动此异能。再动
swiftstrike_bracers.text_en: Action - Destroy this: Your next attack this turn gets +2{p}. Activate this only if you've played a Nimblism this turn. Go again

swiftwater_sloop.text_zh: 涨潮——若你资源区中有2张或更多蓝色牌，此牌获得再动。
swiftwater_sloop.text_en: High Tide - If there are 2 or more blue cards in your pitch zone, this gets go again.

swindlers_grift.text_zh: 当此牌攻击时，你可以弃一张黄色牌。若如此做，抽一张牌并创造一个金币衍生物。
swindlers_grift.text_en: When this attacks, you may discard a yellow card. If you do, draw a card and create a Gold token.

swing_big.text_zh: 当战斗链关闭时，若此牌没有命中，防御英雄创造一个加速衍生物。
swing_big.text_en: When the combat chain closes, if this didn't hit, the defending hero creates a Quicken token.

swing_fist_think_later.text_zh:
作为使用先挥拳后思考的额外费用，随机弃一张牌。
再动
swing_fist_think_later.text_en:
As an additional cost to play Swing Fist, Think Later, discard a random card.
Go again

swordmasters_path.text_zh:
你本回合的下一次剑攻击获得+3力量。
本回合你下一次将磨砺一把剑时，改为额外磨砺一次。
再动
swordmasters_path.text_en:
Your next sword attack this turn gets +3{p}.
The next time you would sharpen a sword this turn, instead sharpen it an additional time.
Go again

swordmasters_shine.text_zh:
你控制的剑上每有一个+1力量指示物，此牌的使用费用减少1点资源。
目标武器攻击获得+5力量。
swordmasters_shine.text_en:
This costs {r} less to play for each +1{p} counter on swords you control.
Target weapon attack gets +5{p}.

sworn_vengeance.text_zh:
你本回合的下一次匕首攻击获得+3力量，以及“当此牌命中英雄时，标记该英雄。”
再动
sworn_vengeance.text_en:
Your next dagger attack this turn gets +3{p} and "When this hits a hero, mark them."
Go again

symbiosis_shot.text_zh:
达什专精
行动——从此牌上移除一个蒸汽指示物：攻击
每当你控制下有机械师物品进入竞技场时，若此牌上的蒸汽指示物少于6个，你可以在此牌上放置一个蒸汽指示物。
symbiosis_shot.text_en:
Dash Specialization
Action - Remove a steam counter from this: Attack
Whenever a Mechanologist item enters the arena under your control, if this has fewer than 6 steam counters, you may put a steam counter on this.

synapse_sparkcap.type_zh: 机械师 装备·基础 头部
synapse_sparkcap.text_zh:
行动——横置此牌，放逐你手牌中的一张进化牌：创造一个沉思衍生物。
战痕
synapse_sparkcap.text_en:
Action - {t}, banish an Evo from your hand: Create a Ponder token.
Battleworn

system_failure.text_zh: 从目标装备、物品或武器上移除所有蒸汽指示物。若以此方式移除了2个或更多蒸汽指示物，对其操控者造成2点伤害。
system_failure.text_en: Remove all steam counters from target equipment, item, or weapon. If 2 or more steam counters are removed this way, deal 2 damage to its controler.

system_reset.text_zh: 放逐你控制的费用为0或1的X个机械师物品，然后将其在其拥有者的控制下移回竞技场。
system_reset.text_en: Banish X Mechanologist items you control with cost 0 or 1, then return them to the arena under their owners' control.
